description: YOLO26s baseline. COCO-pretrained, imgsz 1280, Ultralytics default hyperparameters.
YOLO26s, sequence-level 80/20 split (all 3 videos in train), F2 fitness, early stop after 25 epochs without F2 gain.
c02 + augmentation changes (no HSV, rotation 10, both flips, mixup 0.15, scale 0.2) and a 45-epoch schedule.
c03 at imgsz 1920 (1.5x upscale of the 1280x720 frames), batch 4 to fit memory. Tests whether resolution helps.
2.85x upscale (1st place's 3648 px) via 449x253 crops trained at 1280 with rect; full-frame val and inference at 3648. c04's augmentation otherwise.

Fine-tune c05 best.pt on a 3x2 overlapping grid of 493x493 tiles at imgsz 1408 (2.856x), sliver tiles dropped, 25% empty tiles, square training with mosaic 0.25, mixup 0.25 and exact rot90. Full-frame val at 3648.
c06 with 50% empty grid tiles (was 25%) to cut c06's false alarms on empty frames (213 vs c04's 137), and a 12-epoch schedule since c06 peaked at epoch 6 of 20.
YOLO26m from COCO on c06's data and augmentation (3x2 grid of 493x493 tiles at imgsz 1408, 2.856x; sliver tiles dropped; 25% empty; mosaic 0.25, mixup 0.25, rot90). 50 epochs. Full-frame val at 3648.
c06 at 4x. Fine-tune c06 best.pt on a 5x3 overlapping grid of 352x352 tiles at imgsz 1408 (4.0x), sliver tiles dropped, 25% empty tiles, c06's augmentation and schedule. Full-frame val at 5120.
Continue c09 (4x, 352 px tiles at 1408) on 50% empty tiles (was 25%) to cut false alarms, with c07's 12-epoch schedule. Full-frame val at 5120.

Fine-tune c06 best.pt with stronger scale augmentation (scale 0.5, i.e. random zoom 0.5-1.5x, was 0.2). Train has no starfish above 118 px while val has 24 of 120-228 px that every model misses. Same tiles, other augmentation and 2.85x full-frame val as c06; 15 epochs.

c11 (c06 best.pt fine-tuned with scale 0.5) with fine-tuning settings for an already converged model. c11 (lr0 5e-4, default warmup_bias_lr 0.1) dropped from c06's 0.697 to 0.627 after epoch 1. Here lr0 1e-4, no bias-LR spike, 0.5-epoch warmup, 8 epochs.

c12 (c06 best.pt, lr0 1e-4, no bias-LR spike, 8 epochs) with asymmetric scale augmentation, zoom 0.8-1.8x (was symmetric 0.5-1.5x in c11/c12, 0.8-1.2x in c06). The upper end lets a 118 px train starfish (train max) appear at ~210 px, covering val's 120-228 px close-ups; the lower end stays at c06's 0.8 so small starfish are not shrunk further.

Continue c13 (seed0 last.pt, epoch 8, full-val F2 0.695) for 8 epochs in the regime where c13 was still improving. c13 jumped from 0.663 to ~0.69 when mosaic turned off (epochs 6-8, LR 4e-5 to 2e-5), so here mosaic and mixup are off throughout and LR runs 3e-5 to 1e-5 with no warmup. Augmentation otherwise as c13 (zoom 0.8-1.8, rot90, mixup 0.25, flips).

c06 (best.pt) fine-tuned 15 epochs with a 70/30 zoom mixture, 70% U(0.8, 1.2) + 30% U(1.2, 1.8) (median ~1.09, 15% above 1.5), instead of c13's uniform 0.8-1.8 (median 1.3), to keep c06's 35-80 px recall while learning c13's large close-ups. Training regime otherwise as c14 (mosaic and mixup off, AdamW lr 3e-5 to 1e-5, no warmup). Augmentation otherwise as c13 (rot90, flips, HSV off).

c04 (whole frames at imgsz 1920, 1.5x) on YOLO26m from COCO, with the augmentation learned in c06-c08 (exact rot90 instead of 10-degree rotation, mosaic 0.25, mixup 0.25). Split, schedule and other settings as c04. A stronger 1.5x member for the ensemble.
Fine-tune of c16 best.pt (YOLO26m, 1920) with c04's exact recipe (mosaic 1.0, mixup 0.15, 10 degree rotation, no rot90), batch 2. Tests whether c16's augmentation change cost it vs c04.

Dry run for the train+val retrain. c08 best.pt fine-tuned on train plus val half A (sequences 0/40258, 0/45518, 1/29424, 2/26651 from seq20val_pos; held-out seed-0 half), natural data ratio. Per-epoch val on half B only (1/17665, 1/18048, 1/44160, 1/60510), which nothing has trained on. Measures whether the new data helps, the stopping epoch and the cutoff shift. c15's low-LR regime (AdamW 3e-5 to 1e-5, no warmup, mosaic and mixup off), c08's augmentation otherwise.

Dry run for the train+val retrain. c08 best.pt fine-tuned on train plus val half A (sequences 0/40258, 0/45518, 1/29424, 2/26651 from seq20val_pos; held-out seed-0 half), new data oversampled 2x (every half-A tile listed twice; empty tiles not duplicated). Per-epoch val on half B only (1/17665, 1/18048, 1/44160, 1/60510), which nothing has trained on. Measures whether the new data helps, the stopping epoch and the cutoff shift. c15's low-LR regime (AdamW 3e-5 to 1e-5, no warmup, mosaic and mixup off), c08's augmentation otherwise.
Final train+val retrain of c06 best.pt: c06 augmentation without mosaic/mixup, AdamW lr 3e-5 nearly flat (lrf 0.9), 2 epochs, val off (dry run c18/c19 peaked at epoch 1-2). Use last.pt.
Final train+val retrain of c07 best.pt: c07 augmentation without mosaic/mixup, AdamW lr 3e-5 nearly flat (lrf 0.9), 2 epochs, val off (dry run c18/c19 peaked at epoch 1-2). Use last.pt.
Final train+val retrain of c08 best.pt: c08 augmentation without mosaic/mixup, AdamW lr 3e-5 nearly flat (lrf 0.9), 2 epochs, val off (dry run c18/c19 peaked at epoch 1-2). Use last.pt.
Final train+val retrain of c13 best.pt: c13 augmentation without mosaic/mixup, AdamW lr 3e-5 nearly flat (lrf 0.9), 2 epochs, val off (dry run c18/c19 peaked at epoch 1-2). Use last.pt.
Final train+val retrain of c17 best.pt: c17 augmentation without mosaic/mixup, AdamW lr 3e-5 nearly flat (lrf 0.9), 2 epochs, val off (dry run c18/c19 peaked at epoch 1-2). Use last.pt.

YOLO26l from COCO on c08's exact recipe (c06 data and augmentation (3x2 grid of 493x493 tiles at imgsz 1408, 2.856x; sliver tiles dropped; 25% empty; mosaic 0.25, mixup 0.25, rot90). 50 epochs. Full-frame val at 3648). Tests whether model size keeps paying off past m (s to m on this recipe, 0.697 to 0.721).
YOLOv5s (Ultralytics v5u, anchor-free head; 9.2M params vs YOLO26s 10.0M) on c04's exact config (COCO start, full frames at 1920). Architecture comparison against c04 with everything else equal.
